title: Remember, O Mind
translation: Let my breath return to the immortal wind, and this body end in ashes. Om. O mind, remember what you have done. Remember, remember what you have done.
translation_hi: मेरा प्राण अमर वायु में मिल जाए और यह शरीर भस्म में समाप्त हो। ॐ। हे मन, अपने किए हुए कर्मों को स्मरण करो। स्मरण करो, किए हुए को स्मरण करो।
science: Matter is conserved: when a body is burned, its water and carbon return to the air as vapour and carbon dioxide, and its minerals remain as ash, just as the verse describes.
